topic_name: Resale Option to Purchase (OTP) and deposit
question_template: At the {stage_of_purchase} stage of buying a resale flat (HFE letter obtained: {has_hfe_letter}), what are the Option Fee and Option Exercise Fee rules and what happens next?

overview.quote: You must pay flat sellers an Option Fee when they grant you an OTP, and an Option Exercise Fee when you exercise the OTP.
